declined_list_rows_checked: lock and parity scans (not a lock: different events)
uniqueness.difference: the price gap between twins of the same word in two events of the same day; no card has read it

data.independence_note: the same development events as TRUMPTOPIC1's fit third, LATEWORD and the dropped MENTDRIFT

split.validate_note: the joint Trump-word held-out (Oct 3 to before Nov 5): one read, all families together, on the Head's go

event.entry_rule: buy YES on the cheaper twin at its ask, ask 0.30 to 0.70, one per pair

prediction: 20 to 60 trades: no evidence likely; if n >= 100, PF at 1c 0.8 to 1.2
kill: PF at 1c under 1.0 on the first read, or under 100 trades

outputs.survivor_line: market, rule, PF 1c and 2c, n, days

holds.label: development (own occurrence), shown by TRUMPTOPIC1's fit third and read for LATEWORD
Trump-word families' joint held-out: ONE read for every Trump-word family that passes development, one print, m counting every family (the Head, Nov 16 15:46Z)

look_ahead.decision_instant: D = the later twin's open_time + 1800 s (open and close times only)
look_ahead.entry_quote: the latest two-sided candle ending in [D - 180, D]; the candle jobs end every window at D
look_ahead.exit: hold to settlement: the list's result, read last for traded tickers only
look_ahead.pair_selection: word title, ticker date code, open and close times only

names: Kalshi public API through kalshi-pull (api.elections.kalshi.com), landed runs only

subset_rationale: one rule, its thresholds (gap 0.15 or breadth 27, band 0.30 to 0.70) fixed before any price of these markets was read; breadth's 27 is the median of open-time counts
fee_form: ceil(round(0.07 x n x p x (1 - p) x 100, 9)) / 100 per order; a void refunds the price and keeps the fee
n_floor: no evidence at n = x below 100
